hero.title: Iungo Attendant
hero.description:
The agent that executes, not only replies.

It cancels an order, changes the size, issues a second copy, updates the address, and generates the invoice. Real operations through your ERP, OMS, and WMS APIs — with a full audit.
hero.imageAlt: Iungo Attendant illustration with conversations and automated operations modules.

compliance.title: Full audit and traceability
compliance.description: Every executed operation writes a signed log: customer identification (with LGPD masking), call payload, API response, and consent hash. Ready for internal audit, ANPD, or Procon.

systemScreens.title: The operation that does not need a human for mechanical tasks.
systemScreens.description: Transaction console, connectors, audit log, and exceptions panel.

testimonials.title: An operation that does not sleep.
testimonials.description: Operations and back-office heads who stopped treating mechanical tasks as human work.

sandra.quote: I had 8 people just to reissue a boleto, update an address, and cancel an order. Today there are 2, and they only handle exceptions. The rest runs 24/7 with a signed audit — something my human team did not do.
sandra.name: Sandra V.

henrique.quote: What won the board was the audit. Every operation has a signed hash, 5-year retention, and tracked consent. The LGPD pre-audit passed with no findings for the first time.
henrique.name: Henrique L.

operations.title: 42 transactional operations, ready to use.
operations.description: Native connectors for the main ERPs and OMS platforms in Brazilian retail. Configurable by business rule.
